title: M5Stack Stamp-C3
summary: ESP32-C3 4MB模块，13路GPIO与USB-C；C056-B官方包装为多模块组合，模型展示其中单个模块，贴纸与可拆塑料盖分开。

photos.notes: Exact-SKU near-orthogonal board ROI; coin lies outside main board mask. Same image supplies printed paper pixels, so comparison validates exterior geometry only, not independent artwork fidelity.

limitations: Manufacturer STL supplies the removable cover only; populated PCB geometry is unavailable. Cover triangles and millimetre scale are preserved.

Black PCB envelope and holes are derived from the official dimension drawing and photos; component-side layout remains UNKNOWN. Back photo is surface appearance, not PCB-layout or electrical verification.
Exact-SKU exposed-back photo is an800px oblique multi-product image with a roughly230px-long board ROI. Rectification cannot add detail and remains less sharp than the1200px paper photograph.
One M2 countersunk hex screw and one brass standoff are confirmed by photos. Visible shape/height are estimated; hidden threads and insert construction are not modeled.
No physical hardware measurements; source cover20x34x4.5mm is retained against the documented20x34x4.6mm assembled envelope. Derived placement tolerances are not manufacturing tolerances.
Photograph-informed colors are uncalibrated. Optional headers shown in alternate assembly photos are not assumed mounted in this representative bare module.
assemblyNotes: Original manufacturer cover triangles, one identity rigid transform, scale1. Drawing/photo-derived board, paper and visible hardware remain explicitly estimated; no source geometry stretched.

inspectionGroups.notes: Photo shows removable cover over PCB/standoff.12mm viewer separation makes unknown component face readable; viewing offset is not a manufacturer disassembly dimension. PCB, USB and brass standoff remain in original assembly coordinates.
